Project: /@makerdantheman/Custom-Skills-Workbench; origin https://github.com/makerdan/Custom-Skills-Workbench. Preserve frontmatter, all existing unrelated wording, required links, one-current-pair rules, full task payloads, separate approvals, duplicate/uncertain-write recovery and independent acceptance. ## Failure Gate v4: deliverable locations and limited planner exception

Use this exception only for paired task planning/handoff of a Failure Gate v4 series. Keep all authoritative deliverables—including scripts, documentation, reports, skills, configuration, code, exports, and complete task plans—outside .local/ in tracked paths that survive task-agent merge and enter repository history.

Exception: when the actual host planner or task interface demonstrably requires a .local/ path for task creation, submission, or handoff, the Agent may create or use the minimum necessary temporary staging copy there, subject to ALL of these conditions:

1. Establish the requirement from the actual interface, host instructions, or observed rejection. Habit, convenience, or an unsupported assumption is not sufficient.
2. Before staging an Agent-authored payload, preserve its complete authoritative contents in an appropriate tracked path outside .local/. The staging copy must never be the only copy of a deliverable.

6. This exception does not permit using .local/ skill definitions or mirrors as canonical instructions. Canonical skill sources remain under .agents/. It grants no additional task execution, validation, approval, lifecycle, merge, deployment, or runtime authority.

If the required staging workflow cannot preserve the authoritative deliverable outside .local/ or cannot establish complete persisted-task readback, stop the affected handoff and report the specific blocker. Do not silently broaden this exception or claim successful delivery.

A temporary staging path is not a Failure Gate plan/ID binding, approval source, grant, tier assignment, authorization registry, durable run log, or completion evidence. Failure Gate's genuine authority, selected-tier, finite-budget, independent-supervision, writer/lifecycle, source/bootstrap/runtime, recovery/reclaim and delivery gates remain unchanged. This exception cannot override a higher-priority prohibition or unavailable host permission. Authoring it does not establish that this host requires or supports .local/ staging.

The current project canonical SKILL.md contains the complete narrow exception; unrelated content and runtime gates are preserved; the authoritative definition, amendment report and inert regression guard are tracked outside .local/. Every six-condition clause and the Failure Gate boundary is accounted for in source readback. Independent confirmation and any real planner-staging demonstration are reported separately, never inferred from file authoring or a task label. No existing reviewer is mutated, no FG-02 or later pair is created/advanced, and no skill publication or runtime activation occurs.

## Pre-existing failures to ignore

None authorized. Missing host capabilities, local authority, real staging evidence, independent confirmation or a current GitHub source tree are boundaries, not tests to waive. Do not borrow installation or another task's approval/grant.

## Validation

Source/document authoring and readback only. Existing project evidence says Failure Gate ordinary governance is STAGED; UNKNOWN never means INACTIVE. No task-local execution tier, grant, finite budget or supervisor is supplied by this request or native task number. Do not run imports, tests (including the new source guard), builds, plan/scaffold guards, hooks, direct diagnostics, coordinator/store commands, services/signals, remote CI, cleanup/reclaim, activation or deployment without separately verified applicable authority. Record the guard NOT_RUN unless such authority is actually obtained and used. Do not introduce a fake docs tier, passing check or approval event. Source readbacks are not validated runtime completion.

## Regression Guard

**Covers:** Treating planner convenience as mandatory staging, losing the sole deliverable in ignored .local/, using staging as canonical source or delivery/authority proof, weakening full persisted-plan/dependency readback, or leaking this exception beyond Failure Gate v4 planning.
**Test location:** scripts/test/paired-planner-staging-source.test.mjs
**What it checks:** Static assertions against the actual canonical definition require verified host necessity, prior complete tracked authoritative copy, temporary-only classification, staged and persisted full readbacks including actual dependencies, durable external evidence, canonical .agents-only inputs, unchanged approval/runtime gates and explicit stop on missing prerequisites. Guard source is delivered within this task; execution remains NOT_RUN unless authentically separately authorized.

- .agents/skills/paired-task-orchestration/SKILL.md (the definition to amend)
